reference_sql:
WITH checked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT competitor, product_id
  FROM competitor_prices
),
product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT c.competitor, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COALESCE(SUM(u.units), 0) AS units
FROM checked c
LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = c.product_id
GROUP BY c.competitor

WITH checked AS (SELECT competitor, product_id FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY competitor, product_id), product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY product_id) SELECT c.competitor, COUNT(c.product_id) AS n_products, SUM(COALESCE(u.units, 0)) AS units FROM checked c LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = c.product_id GROUP BY 1

WITH checked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT competitor, product_id
  FROM competitor_prices
), product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT c.competitor, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COALESCE(SUM(pu.units), 0) AS units
FROM checked c
LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = c.product_id
